_source: Real rows captured 2026-09-18 from a live Substack chat channel's last ten daily threads (6,133 comments scanned, 765 hit a broad trade-keyword grep) plus the channel's thread ROOT posts. Author names removed; bodies otherwise verbatim (URLs replaced). Hand-built adversarials cover the 12 semantic failure modes from the slice-1 design review.
_contract: expect[] compares action/qualifier/tickers/confidence. [] means 'no trade rows'. kind=known-miss rows pin deliberate v1 recall gaps. confidence 'low' = ticker inferred from a lowercase word (Telegram alerts mark these as unconfirmed).
